import JFA.TensorProducts
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Compact
import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty
import Mathlib.Topology.Instances.Nat
import Mathlib.Topology.Metrizable.Basic
import Mathlib.Topology.Order

/-! Supporting vocabulary for the five Section 1 results. No paper result is
postulated. All operator ideals are subsets of the actual bounded operator space.
The Mrowka topology is generated explicitly from the paper's neighborhoods. -/

noncomputable section
open scoped ZeroAtInfty TensorProduct
namespace JFA

section Operators
variable (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
variable (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]

/-- Norm-separability of the actual range; the range need not be closed. -/
def HasSeparableRange (T : E →L[𝕜] F) : Prop := TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable (Set.range T)

/-- The scalar-plus-separable property. Nonseparability is a separate hypothesis. -/
def HasFewOperators : Prop :=
  ∀ T : E →L[𝕜] E, ∃ a : 𝕜, ∃ S : E →L[𝕜] E,
    HasSeparableRange 𝕜 E E S ∧ T = a • ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 E + S

/-- Banach-space isomorphism; this does not require preservation of the norm. -/
def Isomorphic : Prop := Nonempty (E ≃L[𝕜] F)

/-- A subspace is complemented precisely when it is the range of a bounded projection. -/
def IsComplemented (W : Submodule 𝕜 E) : Prop :=
  ∃ P : E →L[𝕜] E, P.comp P = P ∧ LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap = W

def compactOperators : Set (E →L[𝕜] E) := {T | IsCompactOperator T}

def separableOperators : Set (E →L[𝕜] E) := {T | HasSeparableRange 𝕜 E E T}

/-- The algebraic linear span of factorizations through F, not its closure. -/
def factorizationSpan : Submodule 𝕜 (E →L[𝕜] E) :=
  Submodule.span 𝕜 {T | ∃ A : E →L[𝕜] F, ∃ B : F →L[𝕜] E, T = B.comp A}

def factorizationOperators : Set (E →L[𝕜] E) := factorizationSpan 𝕜 E F

/-- Closed, linear, TWO-SIDED operator ideal in the original operator norm. -/
def IsClosedOperatorIdeal (I : Set (E →L[𝕜] E)) : Prop :=
  IsClosed I ∧ (0 : E →L[𝕜] E) ∈ I ∧
    (∀ S ∈ I, ∀ T ∈ I, S + T ∈ I) ∧
    (∀ a : 𝕜, ∀ T ∈ I, a • T ∈ I) ∧
    (∀ A : E →L[𝕜] E, ∀ T ∈ I, A.comp T ∈ I ∧ T.comp A ∈ I)

end Operators

section AlmostDisjointSpaces

/-- Every member is infinite, and distinct members have finite intersection. -/
def IsAlmostDisjoint (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) : Prop :=
  (∀ A ∈ 𝒜, Set.Infinite A) ∧
    ∀ A ∈ 𝒜, ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, A ≠ B → (A ∩ B).Finite

/-- Cardinality exactly 2^aleph_0, expressed by an actual bijection. -/
def HasContinuumSize (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) : Prop := Nonempty (𝒜 ≃ Set ℕ)

/-- Distinct points x_n and y_A, as in Definition 4.1. -/
def Mrowka (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) := ℕ ⊕ 𝒜

def mrowkaNeighborhood (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) (A : 𝒜) (G : Finset ℕ) : Set (Mrowka 𝒜) :=
  {p | p = Sum.inr A ∨ ∃ n ∈ (A : Set ℕ), n ∉ G ∧ p = Sum.inl n}

/-- The topology is generated by isolated x_n and the cofinite tails at y_A.
It is defined even without almost-disjointness; the theorems impose that hypothesis. -/
instance mrowkaTopology (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) : TopologicalSpace (Mrowka 𝒜) :=
  TopologicalSpace.generateFrom
    ({U | ∃ n : ℕ, U = {Sum.inl n}} ∪
      {U | ∃ A : 𝒜, ∃ G : Finset ℕ, U = mrowkaNeighborhood 𝒜 A G})

abbrev MrowkaCZero (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) := C₀(Mrowka 𝒜, 𝕜)

/-- Here omega is the discrete natural-number space, not its one-point compactification. -/
abbrev AmplifiedMrowka (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)) :=
  C₀(ℕ × Mrowka 𝒜, 𝕜)

abbrev cZero (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] := C₀(ℕ, 𝕜)

/-- Labels distinguish each positive finite power as well as the two other types. -/
inductive ComplementedModel
  | c0
  | finitePower (n : ℕ)
  | whole
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- finitePower n denotes X^(n+1), so the zero-dimensional power is excluded. -/
def IsModel (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X Y W : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace 𝕜 W] : ComplementedModel → Prop
  | .c0 => Isomorphic 𝕜 W (cZero 𝕜)
  | .finitePower n => Isomorphic 𝕜 W (Fin (n + 1) → X)
  | .whole => Isomorphic 𝕜 W Y

end AlmostDisjointSpaces
end JFA

declarations.name: IsModel
declarations.label: IsModel
declarations.code:
def IsModel (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X Y W : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace 𝕜 W] : ComplementedModel → Prop
  | .c0 => Isomorphic 𝕜 W (cZero 𝕜)
  | .finitePower n => Isomorphic 𝕜 W (Fin (n + 1) → X)
  | .whole => Isomorphic 𝕜 W Y
declarations.signature:
def IsModel (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
    (X Y W : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace 𝕜 W] : ComplementedModel → Prop
  | .c0 => Isomorphic 𝕜 W (cZero 𝕜)
  | .finitePower n => Isomorphic 𝕜 W (Fin (n + 1) → X)
  | .whole => Isomorphic 𝕜 W Y
declarations.doc: finitePower n denotes X^(n+1), so the zero-dimensional power is excluded.
